name: pin-cn-fog-forced
js: (() => { const L = window.__CITY_APP.lightingSystem; L.uFogDensity.value = 0.0009; return { fogDensity: L.uFogDensity.value }; })()

name: pin-cn-fog-cleared
js: (() => { const L = window.__CITY_APP.lightingSystem; L.applyPreset(L.activePresetId, true); return { fogDensity: L.uFogDensity.value }; })()

name: pin-ride-walking-passenger
js: if (!window.__CITY_APP.rideFeatured('504')) throw new Error('Walking passenger boarding failed');

name: pin-ride-flight-cleanup
js: if (window.__CITY_APP.controllerManager.suspended || window.__CITY_APP.streetcarRide.active) throw new Error('Flight cancellation failed');
